title: Transfer - Azure Route Server NVA Reflection Review
goal: Review Azure Route Server and dual-NVA BGP session data, find reflected-prefix preference cycles and unauthorized transit leaks between appliances, judge which route-policy and next-hop changes actually resolve them, and write `/app/output/route_server_reflection_review.json`.
skillBenefitRationale: Moves the skill to a different Azure control plane while preserving its core payoff: detect oscillation, spot valley-free violations, and prefer policy-level mitigations over disabling peerings or removing connectivity in a managed BGP environment.
